summary: Peraso Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing an increase in the maximum shares available under its existing at-the-market offering agreement with Ladenburg Thalmann, raising the cap to $670,000 (with $9,370,130 already sold). This is a routine shelf takedown adjustment, not a special situation. No deal terms, board recommendations, or structural changes are involved. The filing simply expands authorized issuance under a previously effective S-3 registration statement. No further action or risk-arb angle applies.
